title: How Was Smallpox Eradicated?
description:
Smallpox was eradicated by vaccination: health workers travelled to every country where it still lived and vaccinated everyone around each new case, until there was nowhere left for it to go. On the 8th of May 1980, the world's health leaders declared that smallpox was gone.
